snippet.title: UNHOST | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
UNHOST is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as a paranormal detective.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4080080/UNHOST/

Trapped inside an abandoned hospital for seven nights, you are tasked with capturing anomalies. Monitor surveillance cameras, operate a remote-controlled bot, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts.

This trailer shows real in-game footage. 
Captured on PC. Work in progress.

#UNHOST
#horror #gameplay #anomalygame
